message: "users"."token" is added with a volatile default (gen_random_uuid()), which rewrites the whole "users" table while blocking reads and writes.
why: The new value must be computed for every existing row, so PostgreSQL rewrites the table under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock. A constant default, or a stable one such as now(), does not need a rewrite.
safeAlternative: Add the column without a default. Set the default in a separate statement (ALTER COLUMN ... SET DEFAULT, which applies only to new rows), then backfill existing rows in batches.
